# Concurrency Interview

> Core concepts and nine classic problems solved in Java, Python, and Go. A free guide from DesignGurus.io, in plain Markdown, with no account required.

Each page is short and ends with links to full course lessons and free articles. Each description below is the opening sentence of that page.

## Cheat sheets

- [Common Mistakes in Concurrency Interviews](https://github.com/design-gurus/concurrency-interview/blob/main/cheat-sheets/common-mistakes.md): Most candidates who fail a concurrency round know the primitives.
- [Java vs Python vs Go: Concurrency Primitives](https://github.com/design-gurus/concurrency-interview/blob/main/cheat-sheets/java-vs-python-vs-go-primitives.md): The three languages offer the same ideas under different names.
- [Concurrency Interview Question Bank](https://github.com/design-gurus/concurrency-interview/blob/main/cheat-sheets/question-bank.md): Fifty conceptual questions that appear in concurrency and multithreading interviews, each with a one-line answer.

## Concepts

- [Async vs Threads](https://github.com/design-gurus/concurrency-interview/blob/main/concepts/async-vs-threads.md): Threads let the operating system switch between tasks at any moment.
- [Atomics and Memory Visibility](https://github.com/design-gurus/concurrency-interview/blob/main/concepts/atomics-and-memory-visibility.md): Two separate problems hide behind the phrase "thread-safe".
- [Condition Variables and Monitors](https://github.com/design-gurus/concurrency-interview/blob/main/concepts/condition-variables-and-monitors.md): A mutex answers the question "may I touch this data now?".
- [Deadlock, Livelock, and Starvation](https://github.com/design-gurus/concurrency-interview/blob/main/concepts/deadlock-livelock-and-starvation.md): These are the three ways in which a concurrent program stops making progress without crashing.
- [Locks, Mutexes, and Semaphores](https://github.com/design-gurus/concurrency-interview/blob/main/concepts/locks-mutexes-and-semaphores.md): A mutex (short for mutual exclusion) is a lock that one thread at a time can hold.
- [Race Conditions](https://github.com/design-gurus/concurrency-interview/blob/main/concepts/race-conditions.md): A race condition is a bug in which the result of a program depends on the order in which threads happen to run.
- [Thread Pools](https://github.com/design-gurus/concurrency-interview/blob/main/concepts/thread-pools.md): A thread pool is a fixed set of worker threads that take tasks from a shared queue.
- [Threads vs Processes](https://github.com/design-gurus/concurrency-interview/blob/main/concepts/threads-vs-processes.md): A process is a running program with its own private memory.

## Problems

- [Bounded Buffer (Producer and Consumer)](https://github.com/design-gurus/concurrency-interview/blob/main/problems/bounded-buffer.md): Build a queue with a fixed capacity that several threads share.
- [Concurrent Web Crawler](https://github.com/design-gurus/concurrency-interview/blob/main/problems/concurrent-web-crawler.md): Given a start URL and a function fetch(url) that returns the links on a page, return every reachable URL on the same host.
- [Dining Philosophers](https://github.com/design-gurus/concurrency-interview/blob/main/problems/dining-philosophers.md): Five philosophers sit at a round table with one fork between each pair of neighbors, so there are five forks.
- [Odd-Even Printer](https://github.com/design-gurus/concurrency-interview/blob/main/problems/odd-even-printer.md): Two threads share a counter.
- [Print in Order](https://github.com/design-gurus/concurrency-interview/blob/main/problems/print-in-order.md): Three threads call first, second, and third on the same object, one method each, and the scheduler may start them in any order.
- [Readers-Writers Lock](https://github.com/design-gurus/concurrency-interview/blob/main/problems/readers-writers-lock.md): Build a lock that allows any number of readers at the same time but only one writer, and never a reader and a writer together.
- [Thread-Safe LRU Cache](https://github.com/design-gurus/concurrency-interview/blob/main/problems/thread-safe-lru-cache.md): Build a cache that holds at most N entries and removes the least recently used (LRU) entry when it is full.
- [Thread-Safe Singleton](https://github.com/design-gurus/concurrency-interview/blob/main/problems/thread-safe-singleton.md): Create a class that has exactly one instance, built the first time it is needed.
- [Token Bucket Rate Limiter](https://github.com/design-gurus/concurrency-interview/blob/main/problems/token-bucket-rate-limiter.md): Build a rate limiter that many threads call before doing work.
